title: Pedubast I
summary: King listed in CFAH-10 Table 5 (Egypt Dynasty 23).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 23. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-10 (Table 5, "CFAH Solution for Dynasty 23").

sorting_basis.note: Sorted by reign start (CFAH non-anchor dates). No tier 1–4 birth year. The year is the reign-start figure already printed on dates.reign: Reign: 28; Start: 694; End: 666. Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-11-13): was none.
